blocks.html:
Environmental exhaust air and toilet exhaust may be combined in any occupancy downstream of all air inlets of the system provided that such exhaust cannot be recirculated. In Group R occupancies, exhaust from domestic kitchens and toilets/baths from one or more dwelling or sleeping units may be combined at a point downstream of all air inlets of the system.
Section MC 515: Postfire Smoke Purge Systems
